display_name: Manulife (Vietnam) group universal-linked insurance with flexible premium (MoF letter 14548/BTC-QLBH, 27 October 2017): the whole document, Articles 1-29

run.method: one agent, one session, no sub-agents, from BRIEF.md

language.note: Identifiers and comments are English (@lang en). Vietnamese appears only in `-- src:N |` comments generated mechanically from line N of the raw rendering by tools/vnsrc.py quote, and in short runs that tools/vnsrc.py check finds verbatim in it.

source.aid: .aids/law-08-2022-qh15.txt (Law on Insurance Business 08/2022/QH15, read for LAW: forks only; it stops at Article 130)

scope: The whole document: Articles 1-29 in five chapters (two numbered 4), the unnumbered tax paragraph under Chapter 2, and the tables of 12.3 and 24.2(e). NOTES.md section 2 has 141 rows: 118 encoded, 22 inert (headings, descriptions, duties with no measure), 1 reached-and-refused (26.3(ii), a rate the document never sets). Everything the document leaves to the Contract Page, the Certificate, the tariff or the underwriting rules is an input with no default. The Law on Insurance Business is not encoded.
